title: A turn that dies after accepting a mailbox wake leaves the woken work unresumed until another wake arrives
outcome: A turn that dies after accepting a mailbox wake leaves the woken work unresumed until another wake arrives
acceptance: When a root session's runtime turn that was started by a mailbox wake ends in failure (runtime error, crash or host restart) before the woken message is acknowledged, TermAl re-delivers a wake for that unacknowledged message on the session's next available turn, or marks it with a visible typed state naming the remedy; a woken message is never silently left unprocessed. A behavioural test covers the failed-turn case and an acknowledged message is not woken again.
The change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate.
